stageNotes.high-school: You can start exploring careers and building skills now, long before you choose a college or program.
stageNotes.recent-grad: This is a great time to compare college, trade school and short-term training side by side.
stageNotes.in-college: Short career training alongside your classes can help you test a career and build practical skills for internships.
stageNotes.college-grad: Practical, job-specific training can help you connect your degree to the roles you are applying for.
stageNotes.professional: Targeted training can help you move up in your field or prepare for a new responsibility.
stageNotes.changer: Short, low-cost training is a practical way to test a new field before you commit to a longer program.
stageNotes.other: Explore at your own pace. Every result links to free career information.
